telegram-web-app.js is the official Telegram Mini Apps client bridge, downloaded
unchanged from https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js?64 on 2026-10-27.
Documentation: https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps

Hosted locally for offline availability. AER loads it only for Telegram launches
and uses its viewport, safe-area, ready and expand APIs. Telegram identity and
launch data are not passed to AER usage analytics.
